📞 Call Day Scoring
A Call Day is a single-day phone-call blitz. Every meeting booked counts double, and stacking meetings in one day triggers a soccer-style multiplier bonus.
Every meeting 2 pts each meeting booked
⚽⚽ Brace +2 pts bonus for 2 meetings in the day
🎩 Hat Trick +3 pts bonus for 3+ meetings (replaces brace)

Example: book 3 meetings → 3 × 2 = 6 base + 3 hat trick bonus = 9 pts. No multiplier past 3 meetings.
